newsitem.title: FRANCE: CEP sees 1996 net up 10 percent.
newsitem.headline: CEP sees 1996 net up 10 percent.

text.p: CEP Communication, controlled by Havas, said in a statement on Thursday that it expected an increase of around 10 percent in 1996 net attributable profit before amortisation and a similar rise for 1997.
It said consolidated turnover for 1996 was expected to be 11.2 billion francs, down one percent from 1995 levels, but flat on a like-for-like basis.

"The estimations allow us to envisage for 1996 a rise in net attributable profit before amortisation of around 10 percent on 1995 -- 521 million francs -- and a result of similar growth for 1997," it said.
